description: This source file defines the class SugarFieldTime, which is a specialized subclass of SugarFieldBase. It provides methods for rendering edit and search views involving time fields, as well as saving time data to the database within the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SugarFieldTime
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase to handle time field rendering and processing in views.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty template variables for editing a time field, configuring dropdown displays and retrieving user time format.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty template variables for searching by a time field, similar to the edit view setup.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Converts form input into database format and assigns it to the bean object.
